title: Static and Terminal
author: Ivo Hartwell
blurb: Ivo Ravensworth, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when the colony's children start sharing the same dream, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
